zh-CN.title: 学习路线
zh-CN.goal: 把目标拆成可调整的阶段、练习和检查点。

optionalInputs.question: 希望学会什么，有没有明确的成果？
目前基础和已经完成的内容有哪些？
每周可投入多少时间，有没有期限？
有哪些资源、偏好或现实限制？

qualityChecks: 未给时间时先生成可调整阶段，不杜撰每日空闲时段。
依赖关系和复习时间要可见，勾选或改时间后进度计算一致。
不保证固定天数必然掌握，个人进度与共享班级进度明确区分。
zh-CN.missingInformationPolicy: 所有问题均可跳过；使用已有资料，显式列出影响结果的假设，未知事实保留待确认。

en.title: Learning roadmap
en.goal: Break a goal into adjustable stages, exercises and checkpoints.

optionalInputs.question: What should you learn and what output would demonstrate it?
What do you already know or have completed?
How much time is available each week and is there a deadline?
Which resources, preferences or practical constraints matter?

qualityChecks: Without an availability estimate, create adjustable stages instead of inventing a daily calendar.
Expose prerequisites and review time; progress must recalculate after edits.
Do not promise mastery in a fixed number of days; distinguish personal and class progress.
en.missingInformationPolicy: All questions may be skipped. Use known material, state consequential assumptions, and leave unknown facts unresolved.
